scientific_integrity: The infinite-family proof is self-contained. Finite checker output corroborates only its stated ranges. No external independent validation or certificate is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The formula concerns fixed-size edge-hit ranges in complete graphs; the Johnson-graph specialization applies to J(n,2), not general J(n,k). Formal novelty priority across alternative terminology is not independently established.
title: Fixed-cardinality edge-hit traces and sharp closed-neighborhood VC dimension of triangular graphs
